title: Understanding the Fibonacci function
objective: Learn how the recursive Fibonacci implementation works and its trade-offs.

dialogue.speaker: rookie
dialogue.text: Why is this Fibonacci function using recursion?

dialogue.speaker: debugger
dialogue.text: Recursion mirrors the mathematical definition: F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2). It is simple but has exponential time complexity.

dialogue.speaker: rookie
dialogue.text: So what would happen if we called fibonacci of 50?

dialogue.speaker: debugger
dialogue.text: It would be extremely slow. Memoization or dynamic programming would fix that.

question.text: What is the time complexity of the naive recursive Fibonacci implementation?
question.explanation: Each call to fibonacci(n) makes two recursive calls, resulting in a binary tree of calls with O(2ⁿ) growth.
